why: Every derived artifact should carry a cross: a content address its own leaves fold to, by two routes that must agree (src/crossfold.ts), stamped by the one write door (src/artifact.ts) rather than by each writer. An artifact without one is an array a reader can compare to nothing. UNSEALED is a debt and may only shrink; STALE is a fault and fails now, because an address that no longer covers its content is worse than none.
